owner: core/prompt-vault (consumer); producers: softwareco/infra/workstation (capture, primary recovery), softwareco/infra/ds1621-admin (offsite recovery)
decision: ADR-0002, 2026-10-07 (owner: the per-mutation offsite restore is too heavy). A db-test mutation needs the exact captured state recovered from the primary repository, and an offsite recovery drill of the same vault no older than offsite_drill_max_age_days. Replaces the 2026-10-03 rule that also required an offsite restore of the exact state for every mutation.

primary.binding: exact: same snapshot and capture manifest as the receipt; recovered identity and tables equal the capture

offsite.binding: drill: same vault, any earlier capture; restored manifest equals its own capture manifest; AK checked_at no older than offsite_drill_max_age_days

validity: A receipt verifies only while the live vault's branch, HEAD, staged root, working root and every table/schema digest equal the captured manifest, and while its offsite drill is no older than offsite_drill_max_age_days.
accepted_risk: Between drills, changes reach the offsite archive only through the nightly Hyper Backup run, which this verifier does not observe; a broken offsite job is caught at the next drill at the latest.

owner_gates_not_verified.db-stage: Gate B: restore smoke test and migration rehearsal on a restored copy
owner_gates_not_verified.db-prod: Gates B and C: rehearsal plus change record and change window

mutation_binding: The admitted transaction re-checks branch, HEAD, staged root and working root against the verified identity before any write and admits nothing on a mismatch.
